# harness_platform_connector_openai_model (Data Source)

Datasource for looking up an OpenAI Model connector.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "harness_platform_connector_openai_model" "example" {
  identifier = "example_openai_token"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `identifier` (String) Unique identifier of the resource.

### Optional

- `name` (String) Name of the resource.
- `org_id` (String) Unique identifier of the organization.
- `project_id` (String) Unique identifier of the project.

### Read-Only

- `auth` (List of Object) The authentication configuration for the OpenAI connector. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--auth))
- `delegate_selectors` (Set of String) Tags to filter delegates for connection.
- `description` (String) Description of the resource.
- `execute_on_delegate` (Boolean) Execute on delegate or not.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `ignore_test_connection` (Boolean) Ignore test connection when creating or updating the connector.
- `model` (String) The OpenAI model to use.
- `tags` (Set of String) Tags to associate with the resource.
- `url` (String) URL of the OpenAI API endpoint.

<a id="nestedatt--auth"></a>
### Nested Schema for `auth`

Read-Only:

- `auth_type` (String) Authentication type for the OpenAI connector.
- `token` (List of Object) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--auth--token))
- `vertex` (List of Object) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--auth--vertex))

<a id="nestedatt--auth--token"></a>
### Nested Schema for `auth.token`

Read-Only:

- `token_ref` (String) Reference to a secret containing the OpenAI API token.

<a id="nestedatt--auth--vertex"></a>
### Nested Schema for `auth.vertex`

Read-Only:

- `project_id` (String) GCP project ID.
- `region` (String) GCP region for the Vertex AI endpoint.
- `service_account_key_ref` (String) Reference to a secret containing the GCP service account key.
